title: 教育制度論（夏期集中講義）
subtitle: Principles of Educational System
educationalGoal: When we talk about education, we often focus on the educational activities of students and teachers, but we don't focus on the system of education. In this course, we will take up the laws and regulations related to the education. We will deepen our understanding of the current situation and structure, as well as consider its reform trends.
advice:
In this course, students will discuss on the law and regulations as below. Especially we will focus on the laws and regulations that have influenced the administration and policy formation related to school education, and consider their use in specific cases.
 1. The laws and regulations of the basics of education
 2. The laws and regulations of educational system
 3. The laws and regulations of students, teachers, and parents
 4. The laws and regulations of educational activities
 5. The laws and regulations of educational administration
books: Sumiko Ichikawa, Masaaki Katsuno, et al.(2020) Kyouiku Syou-Roppou, Gakuyou-Shobou.
requiredKnowledge: Aiming to obtain a Japanese teacher's license

activityGoals.body: Be able to consider educational system and organization and answer the questions.
Be able to answer the questions about the educational reform and movement.
Be able to explain the problems about the educational regulations and their solutions.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

              When we talk about education, we often focus on the educational activities of students and teachers, but we don't focus on the system of education.
